title: Discovery-mirror inventories are stale after lifecycle registration restoration
evidence: [INFERENCE: direct lstat inventory found 21/18/17/19 resolved symlinks versus README counts 19/16/15/13]
smallestFix: Regenerate mirror counts and add a parity assertion.

title: Copilot hook registrations point at targets with no current source or built artifact
evidence: [INFERENCE: both Copilot dist targets are absent and no copilot source directory exists in the bounded runtime inventory]
smallestFix: Remove the nominal registration and document the fallback, or add a real source/build owner and test it.

title: Copilot fallback mutates a repository document without a declared freshness guard
evidence: [INFERENCE: missing target makes the fallback branch reachable in the current checkout]
smallestFix: Make fallback stdout-only or give the generated file an explicit safe ownership contract.

title: Devin failure guidance still instructs operators to build mcp-server
smallestFix: Use the runtime build command consistently and scan active hook configs for stale package names.
